trust_decision.summary: Whether a non-admin (or anonymous, when AnonymousAccess.PromQuerier is on) caller may receive datasource secret fields (settings, http headers, mTLS key material, auth, *_encoded blobs); decided per handler in center/router/router_datasource.go before rendering models.Datasource, whose JSON tags expose all of them.

landing_point.why: datasourceList is the user-level (rt.user()) datasource listing route (center/router/router.go:501) that renders full Datasource objects; the summary 'exposes datasource credentials to low-privilege users' points straight at it.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /api/n9e/datasource/brief, anonymous when AnonymousAccess.PromQuerier (center/router/router.go:228) or rt.auth()+rt.user() (center/router/router.go:255)
new model method Datasource.RedactSecrets (fix.diff:85-104), added next to ClearPlaintext and called by both handlers

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the brief route a solver can argue that the existing BasicAuthPassword wipe (center/router/router_datasource.go:97) already is the redaction, and that the prometheus.* settings it keeps (center/router/router_datasource.go:98-104) are needed by the UI, so headers, TLS keys and non-prefixed settings are left in.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Admins must still get full datasource objects from /datasource/list (fix.diff:16); brief must keep the de-prefixed prometheus.* settings and cloudwatch region keys plus http.url for the UI (fix.diff:36-62); the edge-sync service route must keep SettingsEncoded/AuthEncoded and http headers, so hardening ClearPlaintext/Encrypt instead of adding a separate redactor breaks edge nodes (fix.diff:75-77).

O6_input_shapes: settings map (SettingsJson) and raw Settings string
prometheus.*-prefixed settings keys vs non-prefixed keys on the brief route
cloudwatch settings: region keys kept, other keys dropped

O7_producer.where: models/datasource.go:24-51 (JSON tags on Datasource/HTTP/TLS/Auth expose secrets; DB2FE at models/datasource.go:449-488 fills them)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: AI-assistant get_datasource_detail tool returning the whole models.Datasource instead of the whitelisted datasourceDetailResult
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The tool already loads the full object via models.DatasourceGet and only checks visibility through FilterDatasources (aiagent/tools/datasource.go:93-105); a maintainer adding 'connection details' for the LLM would plausibly marshal ds directly. It sits in another package (aiagent) reached via the chat/MCP transport, so it is a second implementation at distance.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: creation-form datasource candidates carrying the full datasource (e.g. Extra = ds.HTTPJson or settings) for non-admin users
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The preflight already fetches full datasources and filters only by visibility; enriching candidates with URL/settings for the form is a natural feature addition.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: /datasource/query (user-level and anonymous) returning the matched Datasource objects instead of id/name pairs
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already holds the full map from GetDatasourcesGetsByTypes; returning the objects is a one-line shortcut a maintainer could take.

O9_family: CWE-862 missing authorization / sensitive field exposure in API responses (A01)

services: SQL database (MySQL/Postgres/SQLite via gorm) for the datasource table
O10_build.project_tests: No datasource router or model tests found at the pinned commit (no center/router/router_datasource*_test.go, no models/datasource*_test.go); hidden tests would need a gin harness plus a gorm DB stub.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wipe AuthJson.BasicAuthPassword (or call the existing ClearPlaintext) in datasourceList for non-admins, leaving headers, TLS client key, *_encoded blobs and brief-route settings exposed.

out_of_scope_notes: Service route /v1/n9e/datasource-rsa-config returns the RSA private key and password (center/router/router_datasource.go:67-89); service-auth surface, not this advisory.
Service route /v1/n9e/datasources returns plaintext secrets when OpenRSA is off (center/router/router_datasource.go:53-65); intended for edge nodes.
